occurrences.englishText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes
“Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes

It shall be to you for a fringe,‡ or, tassel that you may see it, and remember all Yahweh’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;

He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north; where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.
